## Use case

What problem are you trying to solve? Who would benefit? A concrete example helps — *"I'm generating a-MgO ensembles and currently have to ..."*

## Proposed solution

What you'd like AmorphGen to do. CLI flag? New mode? Python API addition?

## Alternatives considered

Workarounds you've tried, or other approaches you considered. Helps us understand the design space.

## Additional context

Related papers, links to similar features in other tools, mock-ups, etc.
